caption: MCP Progress Notification Params
description: Parameters for a `notifications/progress` notification. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 ProgressNotificationParams; 2026-07-28 ProgressNotificationParams).
name: mcp_progress_notification_params

mcp_meta.description: MCP member `_meta`: See [General fields: `_meta`](/specification/2025-11-25/basic/index#meta) for notes on `_meta` usage.

mcp_message.description: MCP member `message`: An optional message describing the current progress.

mcp_progress.description: MCP member `progress` (required by the protocol): The progress thus far. This should increase every time progress is made, even if the total is unknown.

mcp_progress_token.description: MCP member `progressToken` (required by the protocol): The progress token which was given in the initial request, used to associate this notification with the request that is proceeding.

mcp_total_float.description: MCP member `total`: Total number of items to process (or total progress required), if known.

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.

mcp_nonconforming_members.description: Named members whose value does not fit the pinned definition, exactly as reported.
